name: rainbow
notes: No known advisories; negative control for RubyGems.
The LLM claims a raw_line that does not appear verbatim in the source file -- must be rejected as fabrication regardless of whether the name/version look plausible.
The version is an unresolved Maven property placeholder, not a literal -- must be rejected rather than guessed.
A real Maven registry lookup for this made-up version returns nothing -- must be rejected. Runs a live check against Maven Central but requires no API key (this is the verifier, not the LLM call).
